game: Ori and the Blind Forest: Definitive Edition
area: Sunken Glades with the Spirit Caverns, from the start through the Wall Jump tree to the Spirit Tree and the way out to the Hollow Grove
sources: files: the Windows depot of Ori DE (app 387290, depot 387291; Unity 5.3.2f1), read with UnityPy: 17 gameplay scenes + 5 dependent art scenes (scene bounds from each SceneRoot's SceneMetaData; colliders, placeholders and MonoBehaviour fields from the level files; hero and Spirit Flame from resources.assets)
mined (kept): the randomizer's location names (sparkle-preference/ori_rando_server bf-areas.ori) for the pickup ids and what each pickup needs from later areas
estimate: the order of play and the minutes (walkthroughs, as before)

units.native: unity units (y up in the game; here y down)
units.how: files: CameraController.FieldOfView 60 (prefab) and DefaultZoom 20 (CameraOffsetController prefab and every Glades scene's SceneSettingsComponent.DefaultCameraZoom) => view height 2*20*tan(30) = 23.09 u, width 41.06 u at 16:9 = 1920 px. Zones zoom to 18-21 u in a few spots (CameraOffsetAnimationZone)

hero.boxSrc: files: seinCharacter prefab (resources.assets) CapsuleCollider radius 0.34, height 1.15
hero.runSrc: files: seinCharacter/abilities/leftRightMovement CharacterLeftRightMovement.Settings.Ground.MaxSpeed 11.6666 (air the same; ground accel 60, decel 30 u/s^2)
hero.jumpSrc: files: SeinJump prefab FirstJumpHeight 3, SecondJumpHeight 3, ThirdJumpHeight 3 (the code defaults 3.75 / 4.5 are overridden); gravity 26 u/s^2 (CharacterGravity), max fall 32 u/s
hero.wallJump: files: SeinWallJump JumpStrength (6, 12) u/s; wall slide max fall 12 u/s
hero.health: 3 life cells (SeinHealthController MaxHealth 12 = 4 per cell). A hit costs ceil(damage / 4) cells (SeinDamageReciever, normal difficulty)
hero.attack: Spirit Flame (files): 2 damage a hit (standardSpiritFlameLevelA), combos of 3 shots 0.2 s apart, 0.5 s cooldown after a full combo, 0.3 s after a broken one; auto-targets within 12 u (SeinStandardSpiritFlameAbility.SpiritFlameRange 12 in the prefab; the code default is 8)
startAbilities: jump (3 u = 140 px; no chained-jump bonus in the prefab)
swim (the Glades water is polluted: WaterZone damage 4 a tick in the shallow pools, 20 = lethal in the deep ones, until the Ginso Tree)
Soul Link: place a save anywhere for 1 energy (needs energy cell 1, ~minute 2)
